schema.description: TenantWideQuery has no parameters: the query is computed across the whole tenant.

spec.description: Uptime for a single check over its execution frequency window, as the app displays it.

schema.description: CheckFrequencyQuery is a CheckQuery plus the check's execution frequency, used to size a lookback window.

frequency.description: Frequency is the check's frequency in milliseconds. Must be positive.

instance.description: Instance is the check's instance label.

job.description: Job is the check's job label.

probe.description: Probe restricts results to a single probe. Empty matches every probe.

spec.description: Number of probes reporting for each check in the tenant, grouped by job and instance. Has no app counterpart yet; anticipates one.
